title: After each compaction, a Sonnet audit agent checks the transcript against the handoff
why: Owner 21:11 CST Nov 12 (via the retrospective): "Some reason the handoff pre compact hooks rnt running well in the cloud, maybe keep a standing thing in ur handoff to send a sonnet agent to cross check your transcript against ur handoff every compaction ? (same for coordinator)". A stale handoff loses rulings and in-flight work across a compaction.
source: owner chat 21:11 CST Nov 12, relayed by the retrospective 21:12 and the coordinator 21:12 CST
note: Home: hooks/precompact_handoff_prompt.md (the post-compaction prompt), so every standing session gets the step without its own handoff line. The prompt names one Explore Sonnet agent with the audit marker `Audit:`; it reads the transcript tail and the handoff and reports lines the handoff lacks or gets wrong. Until it lands: the coordinator, the retrospective and triage each keep a standing handoff line (owner's ask named the retrospective and the coordinator; triage adopts it too). Cost: one agent per compaction, read on demand (rule outcomes-mechanize-rules). Started by coordinator 21:18 CST Nov 12: one lane for both steps, two PRs, the audit line first.
